THE CORNER SHOP — target state, all 5 slices finished.
Slice 1 (the solo sorting loop) is built and playable today. Everything else here is the plan: bills, roles, live co-op, the shared tree.
Colours and metrics are lifted from the real app source, so what's built already looks exactly like this.
Built today — minus the co-op layer: no partner pills, no IN SYNC badge, no claimed item, no on-beat chip.
Roles are slice 3. The Ear's audio items are the one piece needing real assets — short one-shots per item.
